title: AISA: AI Safety Assistant Framework for Continuous Improvement of Highway Construction
abstract: arXiv:2608.17184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and pre-task planning can benefit from prior incident records, yet historical accident data is often stored as unstructured narratives that are difficult to consult at the point of planning. A novel framework centered on large language models (LLMs) for highway construction safety reporting and planning is proposed as a foundation for future agentic applications, prioritizing deterministic, local inferencing. The second is to evaluate retrieval of relevant historical accidents, related imagery, and trusted industry documents for incorporation into daily safety plans. translated_title: AISA：面向高速公路施工持续改进的AI安全助手框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17184v1 公告类型：新 摘要：工作安全分析（JSA）和任务前规划可以从以往事故记录中受益，但历史事故数据通常以非结构化叙述形式存储，在规划时难以查阅。本文提出了一种以大型语言模型（LLMs）为核心的新型框架，用于高速公路施工安全报告和规划，作为未来代理型应用的基础，优先考虑确定性和本地推理。第一个目标是实现事故叙述的分类和质量评分，以支持现有和未来的报告目的。第二个目标是评估检索相关历史事故、相关图像和可信行业文档，以纳入日常安全计划。训练了神经探针，用于对事故进行分类，涵盖四个多类别和两个二分类的职业伤害和疾病分类系统（OIICS）字段，并得出总体质量评分，在测试集上进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于大型语言模型的AISA框架，通过非结构化事故叙述的分类、质量评分和检索，为高速公路施工安全规划提供持续改进支持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based AISA framework that classifies, scores, and retrieves unstructured incident narratives to support continuous improvement of highway construction safety planning.
